name: LG Corp.
summary: Globally, LG Corp., through its diverse subsidiaries, maintains a robust presence across the electronics, chemical, and communication and services sectors. Its extensive electronics portfolio encompasses a wide array of offerings, from consumer goods such as home appliances, air conditioning systems, home entertainment devices, and mobile communication products, to critical vehicle components and various business-to-business (B2B) solutions. This also extends to sophisticated display technologies for televisions, mobile devices, IT, automotive applications, and commercial uses, alongside specialized electronic components like camera modules, photomasks, tape substrates, and semiconductors. In the chemical and materials domain, LG Corp. is a key supplier of advanced materials, including those for batteries, life sciences, and the petrochemical industry. Its offerings further extend to consumer goods like daily necessities, cosmetics, and beverages, as well as high-performance materials such as architectural decorative elements, automotive components, and industrial-grade methyl methacrylate (MMA). The communications and services arm delivers a comprehensive suite of solutions, ranging from telecommunications and advertising and marketing services to specialized IT solutions like customized system development, strategic consulting, and outsourcing. The company also provides space solutions, in-depth economic analysis, industrial research, corporate management consulting, professional sports management, and integrated supply-chain solutions. Its media presence includes cable TV and internet services, operations as a mobile virtual network operator (MVNO), and local television channels. Additionally, it engages in the import and export of textiles and household goods. Established in 1947, LG Corp. maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
